//: Local tooling config for the Edge Functions.
Dependency versions are pinned inline in each function's import statement
(npm:pkg@exact) rather than through an import map here. That is deliberate:
Supabase's remote bundler does not load this file as an import map, so bare
specifiers fail to deploy — the version has to travel with the import.
Why pin at all: these handlers run with SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY,
STRIPE_SECRET_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in scope. A floating specifier
re-resolves on every deploy, so a malicious release upstream would execute
with full database access and live payment credentials. Bump versions
consciously and re-run `deno check` on each function afterwards.
nodeModulesDir is only needed because this repo is a pnpm workspace, which
makes Deno look for a local node_modules when checking npm: specifiers.
